review.notes: Price uncompetitive: 10-packs of 40x40 cm ~340 GSM cloths list at Rs 615 (SOFTSPUN, Flipkart) and Rs 625 (Glosswerkz, Amazon.in), and SOFTSPUN 5-packs sell for Rs 225-355, so the 'Rs 499-695 per 5-pack' basis does not hold on the marketplaces. At Rs 599 margin drops to ~22% (Amazon), at Rs 499 to ~12%; below the 30% target.
